product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Industrial Bookcase, 72 Inch Height, Natural Wood, Black Metal Frame
product.description: Lipped wood shelves keep your belongings securely stored within the simple black metal frame of this towering bookcase. With a modern industrial flair, it makes a perfect display medium to show off your collection without distracting from it. 55”W x 15”D x 72”H 30% metal, 70% wood Sleek, simple design adds a minimalist flair to any office or library A simple black metal frame supports 5 sturdy wooden shelves. Simple assembly in less than 15 minutes Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
